parts.script:
Angela: Hey, Tom! Have you thought about what we should do this weekend?
Tom: Not really. I was thinking we could go hiking if the weather is good.
Angela: That sounds great! I know a place near Lakeview that has some beautiful trails.
Tom: Oh, I’ve heard about Lakeview. How long does it take to get there?
Angela: It’s about an hour’s drive from here. We could leave early in the morning to avoid traffic.
Tom: Sounds perfect. What time do you want to meet?
Angela: How about we meet at my place at 7 AM? That way, we can have breakfast before we leave.
Tom: Good idea! Should we pack some lunch as well?
Angela: Yes, definitely. I can make some sandwiches.
Tom: Great! I’ll bring some snacks and drinks. By the way, don’t forget to bring your camera for the views!
Angela: Of course! I can’t wait to take some photos. It’ll be a fun day out!
Tom: Absolutely! Let’s check the weather forecast before we finalize everything.
Angela: Right! I’ll look it up now and text you later with the details.
